  validation-trace columns, mpf all-or-none constraints), forced-transaction
  journal, foreign-tip reconciliation, e2e runner/supervisor/summary,
  architecture-g artifact producers/verifiers, commit worker pipeline per
  ledger F02-L/A/P rows
- parent repairs during triage: database.test direct-insert fixture gained
  the three new NOT NULL columns; node dist rebuilt (was 3 days stale);
  vite transform caches cleared; disposable midgard_test reset onto the
  current schema with the correct stamp
- gates: full suite 96/108 executed across 144 files with exactly two
  documented emulator failures ledgered as NODE-EMU-DA-SEED (DA-seed env
  plumbing; backlog-pages phaseA rejection); database.test green; tsup
  build clean
fix(review): close recovery and admission findings

goal(onchain): consensus/state-queue/deposit backlog and five-stage decode pipeline

- state-queue commit/merge/removal hardening with Q49 structural controls
  (5/5 selectors), deposit mint-policy exact ten-asset/inclusion-time
  controls (5/5), payout destination/underfunding controls (3/3),
  settlement/ledger-state/transition-trace backlog per F02-L rows
- five-stage canonical-decode item pipeline validators (source, semantic,
  observe, settlement, proof-item) plus staging lib replace the chunk
  validator (deleted) per the complete-item-first necessity program
- ABI test modules (event/scheduler/validation-controls/tail-controls,
  ledger-state) and the batching focused-check runner tracked
- trailing whitespace normalized per the 86fd1d4b convention; compile clean

goal(harness): track the F40/F41 goal verification suite

- all eight exact $13.1 goal:* entrypoints in demo/package.json plus the
  serial runner, closure decoder/verifier (with $0.2 descent semantics),
  capability/fault-proof/static-policy/plan verifiers, closure schema,
  verification doc, fault-proof reconciliation artifact, and the 132-row
  format registry - previously untracked while the committed closure
  manifest bound their hashes
- format-check scoped by .prettierignore to exclude generated trees
- gates tonight: plan verifier PASS, closure current-tree-valid, capability
  PASS, fault-proof 70 rows, registry 132 rows, self-test 7/7

goal(q00-q01): native counted-root port for eight families; proof-state safety suite

- eight legacy-binding families moved to pass_native_tx_to_next_step with
  the legacy PlutusData inclusion path deleted (zero references verified);
  witness-encoding split fixed via verify_native_tx_witness_set;
  withdrawn-reference-input rebinds under WithdrawalsRootDomain counted-root
  membership; min-fee carries binding only (fee stub stays for Q20)
- shared native-binding fixture drives every step-01 positive through the
  real validator handler; forged-root negatives fail at counted-root unwrap
- Q01: 41 selectors across common/computation-thread/catalogue covering
  lifecycle, intra-tx duplicate-init, token coupling, catalogue immutability,
  reference-input identity, shared-layer valid-block rejection; cross-tx
  duplicate-init gap ledgered for Q53
- trailing whitespace stripped per the normalized-formatter convention the
  remote CI defines (86fd1d4b); compile clean post-strip
- gates: parent batch replays 25/25 (14 modules) and 41/41 (3 modules)

goal(docs): propagate invariant 3-4 amendment; formatting normalization

- architecture.md gains the proof-interaction classification section and
  proof-completion.md restates single-party-first (transaction count is
  orthogonal to interactivity) - the companion-lane propagation of the
  owner-adopted spec amendment
- checkpoint docs and registry verifier: prettier formatting only

goal(spec): owner-adopted invariant 3-4 amendment - single-party-first with interactive necessity

- any violation provable by one prover from retained public evidence must
  stay non-interactive; multi-step computation-thread decomposition allowed;
  transaction count never justifies challenge/response; interactive families
  owe executable necessity evidence for interactivity itself
- spec now 1,505 lines at 30a12ec9; evidence artifacts and ledger rebound;
  closure verifier current-tree-valid

goal(validation): validation-machine remediation and boundary-suite backlog slice

- field-order remediated validation-machine/data/wire sources and the
  boundary/breadth/chunk suites; C26 investigation scaffold now imports the
  production gate from midgard-core
- gates tonight: complete-item 16/16, wire 2/2, data-breadth 2/2,
  unary-depth 2/2, tsc clean; heavier retained-DA/journey coverage recorded
  in the validation ledger (F40-RETAINED-DA, CP1-JOURNEY)

- validation-dispute boundary (42-constructor auxiliary schema), fraud-proof

  backlog per ledger rows F02-V10-V14/F02-L18/F02-A
- gate: package suite 94/96; the two fault-proof.test.ts failures are the
  documented mid-ABI-transition state (working-tree SDK expects the post-Q00
  regenerated blueprint, 75 vs 61 semantic resolvers) and close at the IG1
  blueprint rebuild with Q00-OFFCHAIN

- adopts the reviewed per-stage proof-item envelope family (publication cap

  measurements; authentication 14,543; observation 15,872 as the direct-bound

- gates: full core suite 287/288 tonight (single pre-existing
  deployment-manifest identity failure, separately ledgered), C26 suites
  6/6+4/4+3/3, boundary 2/2

goal(lucid): provider payload/types/convenience and partial-signing backlog slice

- exact /protocol-info root+nested rejection (F02-P), provider payload

- gates: provider suites 49/49 (3 files), partial-signing 7/7 (parent runs)
- known open item recorded as C20-LUCID: three committed native-codec
